title: How TDD Shaped HTML6
excerpt: My manager at Eldøy taught me to design libraries test-first, one function at a time. Here's how that discipline shaped HTML6's parser, transpiler, and masking engine.
author: Austin Brage

title: Building a Real-Time Voice AI Tutor
excerpt: Build a voice AI assistant and it defaults to feeling laggy: not the model, the transport. How uLearn's AI tutor stays on one socket, gates the mic with real VAD, and never talks over itself.
author: Austin Brage
